modes.label: Laps
modes.description: Current lap number

modes.label: Position
modes.description: Class (default) or overall race position, optionally shows total cars (scoped to class or full field)

modes.label: Fuel
modes.description: Fuel level as amount or percentage

modes.label: Flags
modes.description: Active race flags with colors and pulsing

modes.label: Track Wetness
modes.description: Track wetness state with a centered vertical 6-segment bar; the current state is the icon title

actions.name: Telemetry Display
actions.description: Custom mustache template display for any telemetry or session variable

actions.name: Pit Crew
actions.description: Multi-mode action for the iRaceDeck audio framework. The initial release exposes only the directional Radar proximity ticks; a Race Engineer voice feature is planned for a follow-up release and will return to the Mode dropdown alongside its voice scenarios. The radar-volume mode moved to the Audio Controls action (#590) — hidden from the Pit Crew Mode dropdown but kept functional so existing buttons keep working.

modes.label: Radar
modes.description: Toggles the directional proximity tick loop on/off

modes.label: Radar Volume Up
modes.description: Deprecated (#590) — moved to Audio Controls. Hidden from the PI but kept functional. Bumps the global Radar volume by 5 (max 100)

modes.label: Radar Volume Down
modes.description: Deprecated (#590) — moved to Audio Controls. Hidden from the PI but kept functional. Reduces the global Radar volume by 5 (min 0)

modes.label: Cycle Delta Mode
modes.description: Cycles through splits delta display modes (next/previous via direction setting)

modes.label: Toggle Reference Car
modes.description: Toggles the reference car display on/off

modes.label: Custom Sector Start
modes.description: Marks the start point for a custom sector

modes.label: Custom Sector End
modes.description: Marks the end point for a custom sector

modes.label: Set Active Reset Point
modes.description: Saves the current car state as a reset snapshot (solo practice only)

modes.label: Reset to Start Point
modes.description: Teleports the car back to the saved active reset snapshot (solo practice only)

modes.label: Take Snapshot
modes.description: Developer tool: saves the current telemetry + session info to disk as timestamped JSON and Markdown files

modes.label: Jump to Fastest Lap
modes.description: Jump the replay cursor to the fastest lap of either the viewed car or always your own car (session-scoped; no encoder support)

modes.label: Next Car (Number Order)
modes.description: Switch camera to next car by number order (includes pit cars, excludes pace car)

modes.label: Previous Car (Number Order)
modes.description: Switch camera to previous car by number order (includes pit cars, excludes pace car)

modes.label: Change All Tires
modes.description: Request all four tire changes using the iRacing #t pit chat macro

modes.label: Toggle Tires
modes.description: Per-wheel selection: LF, RF, LR, RR. Uses shorthand macros (#!t, #!l, #!r) when all, left-only, or right-only tires are selected

modes.label: Change Compound
modes.description: Cycle tire compounds (DRY/WET)

actions.name: Fuel Dial
actions.description: Set pit-stop fuel from a Stream Deck+ dial with a live two-segment touch-strip readout (total after the stop / capacity), also working as a plain keypad button and on a Mirabox knob. Single mode, no Mode dropdown. Dial Mode chooses whether the dial sets the amount to add or the target total to reach; in Target level mode the add (target - current) is rounded up so the stop never finishes under target and is kept topped up every ~30s as fuel burns. The add is sent via the iRacing API (pit.fuel) clamped to the remaining tank space. A configurable Press Action and Elgato-only Long-Press Action (Toggle Fueling / Clear Fueling / Fill To Max); a separate Touch Screen action (same options + None) runs on a touch-strip tap. Trigger descriptions are dynamic. First action to support a Stream Deck+ dial + touchscreen since dial support was de-claimed in #640 (rebuild begun in #681). Communication: iRacing API only (pit.fuel / pit.clearFuel).
